verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Drive's REST API, sharing, uploads, and add-on building blocks, but shows no natural-language command interface for end users (e.g., Gemini in Drive assistant) — the closest item is guidance for building a separate AI agent add-on (google-drive-docs-4), which is a developer SDK, not a shipped NL command capability. Missing for 10: evidence of a built-in conversational/NL command interface, first-party or hands-on examples of users issuing natural-language instructions to Drive, and any confirmation this ships to end users rather than just being buildable by developers.
